leak.history_comparison: the settled 40-60 s slope came back to -11.27, so the -9.25 read on 11-22 did not repeat and now looks like a one-day excursion rather than a new regime. The 11-18..11-21 plateau was -11.11/-11.36/-11.64/-11.13.

leak_first_attempt.detail: the MCU reset 15.3 s after start, while the pump had only reached about 0.8 mmHg. The full bring-up banner stream then appeared mid-capture and the "hold sensor/transport discontinuity: [Boot] after probe" guard voided the round. The retry 2 min later completed normally with an identical baseline.

reset_evidence.interpretation: pure PIN means NRST was pulled low while VDD stayed up. A power dip would also set PORRSTF, an IWDG timeout (4000 ms, debug-freeze=ON) would set IWDGRSTF, and a software reset would set SFTRSTF. None did.

sealed_zero_notes.note: sealed zero -0.05 / +0.04 across the two sealed states, vent +0.04, so the coil offset is +0.09 by the first pair and +0.57 by the second. Both states sit inside +/-1; this is the smallest vent/seal spread of the batch.

zero_arc_note: the day opened without a latched fault (code=0 NONE, ADSdiag errors=0 recoveries=0) and with the profile in mode=normal, so unlike D6 the SENSOR_INIT workaround was not needed. The only disturbance was an MCU reset during the first leak hold, see leak_first_attempt.reset_evidence.

reset_evidence.corpus_scan: 1991 ndjson files under tmp/omniprobe and data/raw contain exactly four reset banners, all 0x04000000 PIN-only: 2026-11-09T11:01:14 (dataset_step240b_20261109), 2026-11-10T18:11:09 (sag_test_20261110), 2026-11-21T11:11:52 (d6_state3), 2026-11-23T11:14:37 (daily_leak_20261123). data/raw contains none, so no recorded capture round has ever been cut short by a reset.
reset_evidence.suspects: NRST is reachable from the USB-serial DTR/RTS lines and the ST-Link. tmp/direct_serial_bridge_20261107.py:95 opens the port with serial.Serial(port, BAUD, timeout=0.05) and never asserts dtr/rts=False, so pyserial drives those lines on open. This matches the earlier D4/D5 note that "dtr/rts 1/1 sometimes helps" on a dead COM12, but the two were never correlated with RCC_CSR before today. Not fixed during the batch: changing the bridge would restart the batch.

valve_width_detail.note: the blended flow recovered from 0.17630 to 0.22057, but unlike yesterday the two widths moved in opposite directions: 3 ms 0.11042 -> 0.28333 (up) and 4 ms 0.24219 -> 0.15781 (down). The blend therefore reflects which width dominates, not a common shift.
